> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write in the present tense as if it is three months in the future.
>
> Where do I want to be and how do I want to feel in three months?

## Mental Health

- I want to be more resilient and continually tackling my fears as they arise.
- I want to feel that I am using my time in ways I find meaningful and that are based on who I want to be.
- I want to cement all mental health routines and setup shortened routines in case of unplanned occurrences.

## Personal

- I want to get better at developing goals
- I want to have a system in place that compounds the value of each task into a larger result.
- I want to continue working on my relationship with Sam, specifically how I can make her more comfortable talking to me about her feelings when she is overwhelmed.
- I want to make time to see friends and people important to me every week or two.
- I want to figure out my vision for life and the values I hope to implement while living.

## Professional

- I want to continue learning in order to stay relevant in my field
- I want to being applying to jobs each day if I do not already have a job.
- I want to practice maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
